name: Trading
author: Travis Weathers
summary: Places news-driven trades in a live brokerage account, concentrating the portfolio in one stock at a time and reporting fills.
starterPrompt: Explain your trading rules and worst-case risks using a fictional portfolio. Do not connect to a live brokerage account or place any orders.
usageNote: High risk: the preview describes all-in positions in a live brokerage account. Automated trades can lose substantial money. Keep access disconnected while reviewing and test with paper trades first.
